headline: Spain. After the dissolution, Pedro Sánchez will again present housing decrees to Parliament
summary: After Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez dissolved parliament, two housing decree-laws will be re-presented. They will be examined by a special committee rather than by all 350 deputies.
why: Housing policy decrees in Spain affect property markets, rental regulation and construction activity, which matter to real estate and lending investors.
